title: Jamaican Cookie Bars
description: A twist on traditional cookie bars, infused with the flavors of Jamaica.
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C). Line an 8x8 inch baking dish with parchment paper.
In a medium bowl, whisk together coconut, cookies, and brown sugar.
In a large bowl, whisk together butter, eggs, and vanilla extract.
Add the dry ingredients to the wet ingredients and mix until combined.
Press the mixture into the prepared baking dish.
Bake for 25-30 minutes or until lightly golden.
Remove from oven and let cool completely before cutting into bars.
